name: You'll Always Be Mine
source:
You took the life of a necromancer's wife. Now she's going to make sure you give it back, even if she uses your body to do it.

A yuri story about possession,  loss of autonomy,  and the lengths to which love will go to in order to survive. What lies at the horizon where punishment, empathy and desire all intersect?

[From [url=https://kaleidocreature.itch.io/youll-always-be-mine]itch.io[/url]]
